traceability.notes: All behavioral requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 026.0-DEV-ELSE-IF-ANNOTATION-POSITION are implemented and verified. The code in branch-annotation-helpers.ts adds formatter-aware else-if handling that (1) preserves detection of annotations immediately before the else keyword, (2) falls back to comments between the else-if condition and the body, and (3) further falls back to the first comment-only lines inside the consequent block. It also adjusts auto-fix insertion to place annotations inside the else-if block body in a Prettier-stable position. Dedicated unit tests exercise detection priority and auto-fix placement, rule-level tests ensure enforcement and error reporting on else-if branches, and an integration test file exists to validate Prettier-formatted else-if chains. The rule documentation has been updated with a detailed description of the supported positions, their precedence, and Prettier compatibility. The full test suite passes, showing no regressions to other branch types. Therefore this story is fully implemented.
